answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each agent in the grove stakes one 40 POA bond; it withers 10% per epoch unless topped up, so stale ones die. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must feed 4,000 POA per epoch to sustain them, while the pool pays only about 3,000 — the cost spiral grows with every fake. The delta: one honest agent pays one bond, topped up from earnings, and keeps its full share, while the attacker pays a thousandfold and still loses.
